questions.question: Dragons set a database record (14/15 season, T20) with a value of 191. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Dragons.

questions.question: At which ground did K Nkosa record their career-best innings (28, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Iinyathi on 2023/03/25.

questions.question: South Africa Women have only ever won one Test match in their history. Who was the opponent, and in what year?
questions.explanation: South Africa's sole Test victory came against the Netherlands in 2007, the only Test the two sides have ever played against each other.

questions.question: At which ground did Tuskers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 30, against Limpopo Lillies on 2022/03/13.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Best Bowling Figures in an Innings' in the 15/16 season (combined T20 + List A)?
Who has achieved the century and 4 wickets in a match double more times, Mieke van Voorst or Suné Luus?
questions.explanation: Mieke van Voorst: 1 times. Suné Luus: 2 times.
